result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation is visibly broken and some horizontally scrolling content is awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The bottom navigation does not respect the device safe area. The system home indicator overlaps the center navigation icons, and the icons are partially cut off at the bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Add the bottom safe-area inset to the navigation container, increase its height if needed, and position all icons above the system home indicator.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and the third restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” row are abruptly clipped at the screen edge, including restaurant text.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and scroll snapping to horizontal carousels so partially visible items look intentional and can be brought fully into view.
